item.tib: gdugs dkar po can gyi dbang gi rim pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho
item.coloph: ces gshen rab mchog de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug gtor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i phyir bzlog pa chen po/ rigs sngags kyi rgyal mo'i rgyud las smin byed dbang gi rim pa bdud rtsi rgya mtsho 'di yang / grogs kyis bskul ngor snyoms las kun grol grags pa bdag gis shar rgyal mo rgya yi rong chen gyi byang phyogs khro chen rgyal po'i khab su/ dus kyi pho nya ces pa/ sa pho rta yi lo/ hor zla bcu pa'i tshes la brtsams pa 'di yang mdo sngags kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus kun du rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
